protocol.cells: policy bit 0; occupied parity bit 1; simultaneous color/turn reversal bit 2; first P color bit 3; 48 cycles
protocol.subset: cycle modulo 3 equals 0: 16 families in every cell, fixed before admission
protocol.sampling: Original complete B1/12% and B4/2% trajectories; occupied 12/13; both-turn D4/color canonical exclusions from occupied 12 onward, root and every legal child; ascending attempts; no outcome replacement
protocol.independence: Prospective claim: new source families, no historical direct roots/children or declared ancestry from occupied 12 onward, under verified available indices. Root admission excludes complete generated nonterminal trajectories and root children, including previous confirmation and both native screens. Early common prefixes below occupied 12 are allowed. Later played transpositions, terminal convergence and unrelated internal-tree states do not redefine source membership. Audit all indexed played overlaps with historical roles; any actual direct-target reuse/unresolved role limits broader board-novelty claims. No retrospective removal, replacement, retuning or promotion. No claim that every internal search state is novel.
protocol.warmup: Restart both processes before each game; B and P each search the same first four disclosed engineering roots at fixed depths 3 and 5 using its own evaluator. All warmups outside scored elapsed budgets; B/P execution order alternates with game parity.

statistics.test: One-sample Student t on family scores against .5; approximate one-sided 97.5% lower bound. Bonferroni across two budgets controls familywise .05; primary failure cannot be rescued.
statistics.bootstrap: Percentile two-sided 95% whole-family sensitivity intervals; joint matched-family resamples for 300-minus-80; same draw retains both budgets; no pooling budgets as independent
statistics.bounded: mean - sqrt(log(1/.025)/(2*n)); independent bounded family scores [0,1], stable timing regime; simultaneous Bonferroni .05
statistics.decision: Both t lower bounds >.5, both bootstrap lower endpoints >.5, and integrity required for credible conventional two-budget evidence; report separately whether both Hoeffding bounds >.5. Disagreement explicit. No automatic promotion.
statistics.subgroups: Policy/parity/turn scores and phase telemetry descriptive only; no additional superiority tests; moves are not strength samples
statistics.sensitivity: 10,000 complete-family percentile resamples; additional seeds +1,+2 for 95% sensitivity; matched budget difference jointly resampled. Student positive-tail quadrature. No subgroup superiority claims.

protocol.stopping: Fixed samples, no interim significance testing. Stop only for correctness, provenance, resource or execution integrity; retain completed receipts and prefixes; no replacement, extension, retraining, optimization or promotion.

engine.isolation: Separate persistent process per evaluator; restart both before each game, symmetric model-specific depth 3/5 warmup on the same disclosed roots. No shared TT or cross-game history.
